claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows multiple blue plastic drums.
The report does not confirm if they are food-grade or safe for water storage.
The witness identifies them as plastic drums, not steel.

risks.proof: Clear photo of the interior and any manufacturer labels/stamps indicating food-grade status.
Video of the drums filled with water or a close-up of the bottom and seams.
Photo of the capacity marking on the side or bottom of the drum.

risks.risk: Lids do not provide a watertight seal.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the lid gaskets and locking rings.

proof_requests: Photo of the manufacturer's stamp or label showing the capacity in liters.
Photo of the interior of the drums to check for residue or stains.
Photo of the recycling symbol/material code (e.g., HDPE 2) to determine food-grade suitability.
Close-up of the lids and any sealing rings.
response.reason: The items are clearly identified as used plastic drums. They can be priced at the worst-case scenario for industrial use at a minimum standard volume.
